card: This PR corrects HTTP status codes and error responses for malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, returning HTTP 200 OK with an error payload and an id of null when omitted. In debug builds with authenticated RPC, malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests tripped an Assume assertion and crashed bitcoind. In release builds, this fixes compliance with the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification by preventing HTTP 400 errors and ensuring invalid requests missing an ID are returned as error objects rather than dropped as notifications.
changed_since_previous: Added commit 7f7428b457 to ensure invalid JSON-RPC 2.0 requests missing an id are not treated as notifications, replacing dynamic id checks with an explicit m_notification flag set only upon successful parsing.
evidence: PR description documents a crash in debug builds on master: 'httprpc.cpp:46 UniValue JSONErrorReply... jreq.m_json_version != JSONRPCVersion::V2 check failed.'
Commit 72c7498ab7 explains that release builds returned non-compliant HTTP 400 responses and omitted required 'id': null fields.
problem: Error handling in httprpc assumed any request parsing failure implied the JSON-RPC version could not be identified. On debug builds, this triggered an Assume() assertion failure that crashed the node when receiving an authenticated malformed 2.0 request. In release builds, it returned HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 200 required by JSON-RPC 2.0, and malformed requests lacking an id in batches were mistakenly treated as notifications and suppressed without error replies.

risk.why: Flaws in RPC parsing and response handling could format responses incorrectly or drop errors, disrupting RPC clients.

summary: Updates HTTP and JSON-RPC error handling for malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests. When an authenticated request specifies JSON-RPC 2.0 but fails parsing (e.g., missing method or invalid params), the node returns HTTP 200 with a JSON-RPC error payload and an id of null if omitted, rather than returning HTTP 400 or crashing. It also ensures unparseable requests without an id are not treated as silent notifications.
